lens: ENGINEERING RECOMPUTE AND APPLICABILITY - Controller, auxiliary supplies, PWM/fault logic and interconnect

checked_items.item: TPS2640 UVLO/OVP pin thresholds 1.19 V rising (1.225 max) / 1.1 V falling (1.125 max) and the derived ladder 107k/4.42k/10k -> UVLO 10.02/9.26 V, OVP 14.45/13.36 V
checked_items.evidence: SLVSFQ6A text (fetched in this run): V(UVLOR) 1.19 typ / 1.225 max, V(UVLOF) 1.1 typ / 1.125 max, V(OVPR)/V(OVPF) identical. Ladder recomputed: 10.02 / 9.26 / 14.45 / 13.36 V; worst case 9.55-10.50 V and 13.76-15.16 V as stated. Side note: the OVP re-enable (falling) threshold can be as low as 12.72 V worst case, inside the 10.8-13.2 V band - a recovery-hysteresis effect, not a false trip.
SLVSFQ6A current-limit table rows for 120 k, 12 k, 8 k and 5.36 k match the agent's values exactly.

checked_items.item: eFuse trip margin stated as I_OL(min) 1.425 A / 0.77 A = 1.85x with MODE = open
checked_items.evidence: SLVSFQ6A section 9.3.5.1.2: in circuit-breaker mode (MODE open) the device does not current-limit; it starts a timer when I_LOAD exceeds the circuit-breaker threshold I(CB) = 12/R_ILIM - 0.03 A (Eq. 4; table: 120 k -> 0.045/0.073/0.11 A, 5.36 k -> 2.0/2.21/2.4 A), turns the FET off after tCB(dly) 4 ms and retries after 540 ms. For 8.06 k: I_CB = 1.46 A typ, roughly 1.3 A minimum.
checked_items.correction: Quote the margin against I_CB (about 1.3-1.6 A for 8.06 k): about 1.7x at 0.77 A; re-check once the relay/fan budget is settled.

checked_items.item: TPS2640 dVdT: t = 8e3 x V_IN x C -> 9.6 ms at 12 V, slew 1.25 V/ms; default ramp 23.9 V in 1.6 ms
checked_items.evidence: SLVSFQ6A: I(dVdT) 4/4.7/5.5 uA, GAIN(dVdT) 24.6, tdVdT 10 ms for 23.9 V with 47 nF and 1.6 ms with C open. Gain form: slew = 24.6 x 4.7 uA / 100 nF = 1156 V/s typ (984-1353 V/s) -> 10.4 ms at 12 V (8.9-12.2 ms); the agent's 8e3 constant is 8 % optimistic in time; I_C 0.19-0.26 A vs 0.24 A stated - immaterial.
checked_items.correction: Use slew = 24.6 x I_dVdT / C with the 4-5.5 uA tolerance and quote the 8.9-12.2 ms band.

checked_items.item: TPS2640 IMON gain 72/78.28/85 uA/A, R_ON 210 mohm max at 85 degC, MODE options, reverse blocking to -42 V
checked_items.evidence: SLVSFQ6A: GAIN(IMON) 72/78.28/85 uA/A; RON 210 mohm max at TJ 85 degC; MODE open = circuit breaker with auto-retry, 402 k = current limiting with latch, short = current limiting with auto-retry; Figure 9-5 reverse input protection at -42 V.

checked_items.item: UCC14141-Q1 input current model P_in = 0.48 W + 1.92 x P_out (40 mA no load, 200 mA at 1.0 W)
checked_items.evidence: SLUSF10B: IVIN_ON_NO_LOAD 40 mA; IVIN_ON_FULL_LOAD 200 mA at IVDD-VEE = 40 mA x 25 V (1.0 W) and 270 mA at 60 mA x 25 V (1.5 W, 11.4-12.6 V). The 1.5 W point gives k = 1.84; the 1.92 used is slightly conservative.

checked_items.item: UCC14141-Q1 claim 'both modules < 1.0 W (8-18 V rating), so a dip below 10.8 V degrades nothing'
checked_items.evidence: SLUSF10B electrical table: input range 8-18 V is specified for 0.7 W at (VDD-VEE) = 25 V, TA = 85 degC, and 1.2 W for 11.4-12.6 V at 85 degC; the Features line gives 1.5 W (10.8-13.2 V) and 1 W (8-18 V) at TA <= 85 degC; section 7.10 defines the SOA as the lower of the 1.5 W limit and the thermal derating curve at each VIN. A flat 1.0 W figure does not cover the 10.8 V / power-board-temperature corner. The gate-driver agent flagged the same.
checked_items.correction: Replace the flat claim by a reading of the SOA/derating curves at 10.8 V and the actual power-board ambient, using a consistent LS load.

checked_items.item: UCC14141-Q1 UVLOP rising 7.8/8.2/8.5 V, PG active-low open-drain, ENA thresholds, soft-start time-out 28.4 ms
checked_items.evidence: SLUSF10B: VVIN_UVLOP_RISING 7.8/8.2/8.5 V; 'Active low power-good open-drain output pin'; VEN_IR 2.1 V max rising, VEN_IF 0.8 V min falling (3.3 V GPIO drive is adequate; ENA absolute maximum 7 V); tSOFT_START_TIME_OUT 28.4 ms. The ENA threshold the agent listed as unverified is now verified.

checked_items.item: UCC21710-Q1 interface parameters: VINH 1.85-2.31 V, VINL 0.99-1.52 V, R_IN 28.5-113 k, TINFIL 28/40/60 ns, tPD 60/90/130 ns, skew 30 ns, IVCCQ 4 mA max, IVDDQ 5.9 mA max, RST/EN low > 1000 ns, TRSTFIL 400-800 ns, 50 k internal pull-down, FLT/RDY open drain, APWM 380-420 kHz, interlock
checked_items.evidence: SLUSDH8D text (fetched): all values found as stated; 'The RST/EN is pulled down internally by a 50k resistor, and is thus disabled by default when this pin is floating'; Table 7-1 and section 8: 'the output is logic low while both IN+ and IN- are logic high', cross-wiring PWM_T/PWM_B exactly as the agent describes.

checked_items.item: APWM decode: 'duty 10 % at 0.6 V to 88 % at 4.5 V', D = 0.10 + 0.2 x (V_AIN - 0.6)
checked_items.evidence: SLUSDH8D: 'The AIN voltage input range is from 0.6V to 4.5V, and the corresponding duty cycle of the APWM output ranges from 88% to 10%. The duty cycle increases linearly from 10% to 88% while the AIN voltage decreases from 4.5V to 0.6V ... When AIN is floating ... approximately 10% duty cycle.' The sensing agent's 'open sensor = 10 % duty' matches the datasheet; the controller agent's polarity is inverted.
checked_items.correction: D = 0.88 - 0.200 x (V_AIN - 0.6 V). A hot NTC (low V_AIN) gives a HIGHER duty and a higher RC-filtered voltage, so the OTP comparator and the firmware decode must trip on rising filtered voltage / duty. Magnitudes (0.2/V, 13 mV and 67 ohm per eCAP count) are unchanged.

checked_items.item: TMS320F28335 supply currents (IDD 290/315 mA, IDDIO 30/50, IDD3VFL 35/40, IDDA18 30/35, IDDA33 1.5/2 mA), XRS timing, power sequencing
checked_items.evidence: SPRS439 text (V1 cache): operational row 290/315, 30/50, 35/40, 30/35, 1.5/2 mA; 'XRS must be pulled low at least 8 us prior to VDD reaching 1.5 V' and 'low at least 1 ms after VDD reaches 1.5 V'; 7.9.2: VDD reaches 0.7 V before or at the same time as VDDIO.

checked_items.item: Default state of DSP-driven control nets at reset
checked_items.evidence: SPRS439: 'The pullups on GPIO0-GPIO11 pins are not enabled at reset.' PWM_H/L (GPIO0/1), ARM (GPIO2), RELAY_ON (GPIO3), RESET_N (GPIO4), BIAS_EN (GPIO5) and DSP_TRIP_N (GPIO6) float from XRS release until firmware configures them. The agent defines pull-downs only on RELAY_ON and BIAS_EN and relies on the UCC21710 internal 50 k on RST/EN (verified). Safety is preserved because RDY low keeps the latch cleared, but ARM, PWM_H, PWM_L and DSP_TRIP_N are undefined CMOS inputs (SN74LV21A datasheet: unused inputs must be held at VCC or GND).
checked_items.correction: Add 10 k pull-downs on PWM_H, PWM_L and ARM at the gate/latch inputs and a pull-up on DSP_TRIP_N (and on ESTOP_N for an unpopulated header).

checked_items.item: TPS3808G01 supervisor: 105 k / 10 k = 4.5 V threshold, CT open 20 ms
checked_items.evidence: TPS3808 datasheet (V1 cache): TPS3808G01 VIT = 0.405 V, hysteresis 1.5 % typ / 3 % max, CT open 20 ms (12-28 ms). 105 k / 10 k gives 0.405 x 11.5 = 4.66 V (release up to about 4.80 V), not 4.5 V; 4.5 V needs about 101 k / 10 k.
checked_items.correction: Either state 4.66 V (power-down margin becomes 1.18 ms; the 5 V rail must stay above about 4.80 V) or change the top resistor to 101-102 k.

checked_items.item: TPS54302 (4.5-28 V, 3 A, 400 kHz, EN threshold) and TPS767D301 (dropout 350 mV at 1 A, theta_JA, T_J max 125 degC)
checked_items.evidence: TPS54302 datasheet: fixed 400 kHz, VEN rising 1.23 V typ / 1.28 V max, falling 1.16 V, VIN UVLO 4.1 V rising; TPS767D3 datasheet: thermal resistance 28 degC/W for the 28-terminal PWP, dropout 350 mV typ at 1 A, TJ max 125 degC. The agent's 40 K/W is a conservative bound (T_J 89 degC at 28 K/W versus 106 degC stated). The EN threshold listed as unverified is now verified.

checked_items.item: Logic timing: SN74LVC1G74 5.9 ns, SN74LVC2G08 4.7 ns, SN74LV21A assumed 15 ns at 3.3 V
checked_items.evidence: LVC1G74: 'Maximum tpd of 5.9-ns at 3.3-V'; LVC2G08: 'Max tpd of 4.7 ns at 3.3 V'; SN74LV21A (SCES340F, fetched): VCC 3.3 V +/- 0.3 V tpd max 8.5 ns (15 pF) / 12 ns (50 pF), 6 ns max at 5 V. The 15 ns assumption is conservative; latency becomes 2 x 12 + 5.9 + 4.7 + 9 + 60 + 130 = 234 ns.

checked_items.evidence: Every pin number in dsp_pin_map matches the CSV (GPIO0-6 = 5,6,7,10,11,12,13; GPIO7-17 = 16-20,21,24-28; GPIO18/19 = 62/63; GPIO21/22 = 65/66; GPIO24-27 = 68,69,72,73; GPIO28 = 141; GPIO29 = 2; ADCINA0-A4 = 42,41,40,39,38; ADCINB0-B3 = 46-49; XRS 80; XCLKIN 105; X1 104; X2 102; GPIO84-87 = 169,172,173,174; JTAG 76-79 and 85-87; ADCREFM/P/RESEXT 55/56/57). EPWM1A/B on GPIO0/1, TZ1-6 on GPIO12-17, ECAP1-4 on GPIO24-27 and SCIRXDA/TXDA on GPIO28/29 are correct F28335 mux options; the A1/B1 simultaneous pair is valid.

checked_items.item: Connector pin assignment: '25 ground pins', PWM pins guarded, analogue group separated
checked_items.evidence: Counting the listed assignment gives 24 GND pins (3 x 12 V, 17 digital, 2 x 3V3, 4 analogue, 24 GND = 50). PWM_H (14) neighbours 12/13/16 and PWM_L (17) neighbours 15/18/19 are all GND, so the guard claim holds.

checked_items.item: Connector nets versus the architecture partition (OPA2320 difference amplifiers and REF3125 on the control board; AMC1311 and TMCS1133 on the power board)
checked_items.evidence: architecture.json places 'OPA2320 front ends' and REF3125 on the control board and the two AMC1311B on the power-board barrier line; sensing_protection.json derives the TMCS1133 V_OC (0.750 V) from REF3125 through 2.32 k / 1.00 k. The controller's connector carries only single-ended VIN_SENSE / VOUT_SENSE and no V_OC net, so the AMC1311 OUTP/OUTN pairs and the OC reference have no path.
checked_items.correction: Either move the OPA2320 difference stages and the V_OC divider to the power-board SELV strip (ratiometric from 3V3_PWRBOARD) or add four analogue pins (VIN_P/N, VOUT_P/N) plus a V_OC pin to the analogue group; define or drop ISENSE_REF, which the sensing agent does not specify.

checked_items.item: Relay coil budget (83 mA, TE T9AS1D12-12 class) and 1N4148W flyback diode
checked_items.evidence: sensing_protection.json selects Omron G9EA-1 DC12 with a 417 mA coil; architecture.json records the conflict (about 1.13 A at 10.8 V). Recomputed: 0.402 + 0.294 + 0.417 = 1.11 A at 10.8 V -> 1.28x on I_OL(min) 1.425 A and about 1.17x on I_CB(min) about 1.3 A; a 1N4148W-class diode (150-300 mA) is undersized as the freewheel path for 417 mA.
checked_items.correction: Re-run the budget with the relay actually selected; if G9EA-1 stays, use PWM hold (sensing agent's proposal) or a lower-power relay, re-select R_ILIM, and use a >= 1 A freewheel diode.

checked_items.item: Fan connection point
checked_items.evidence: The design basis says 'external 12 V fan'; assumptions.json budgets a 6 W (<= 0.5 A) fan inside the 2 A auxiliary supply; the agent writes 'fans external'. If the fan hangs on the protected rail the load reaches about 1.6 A at 10.8 V with the G9EA-1 coil, above I_CB.
checked_items.correction: State explicitly that the fan is fed upstream of the eFuse (directly from the 12 V entry) or include it in the ILIM/I_CB selection.

checked_items.item: KR-GD-008 applied through its exclusion (buffered single-ended PWM for short links) to a board-to-board mezzanine
checked_items.evidence: Rule text: exclusion 'Short on-board links, where buffered single-ended PWM with RC filtering is acceptable'. A <= 15 mm stacked mezzanine with 24 ground pins is a defensible extension; the agent labelled it 'adapted', recorded CB-GD-003 as the fallback and kept RC filters and pull-downs at every receiving pin. The rule's verification (measurement; open-connector test keeps outputs off) must be carried into the test plan; the 10 k pull-downs plus the UCC21710 internal pull-downs give fail-safe-off on an open connector.

knowledge_misuse: UCC14141-Q1 '1.0 W over 8-18 V' (CMP-UCC14141-Q1 Features-line parameter, condition TA <= 85 degC) was used as an unconditional rating to claim that a dip below 10.8 V 'degrades nothing'; the datasheet electrical table specifies 0.7 W for 8-18 V at TA = 85 degC / 25 V output and defines the SOA as the lower of the 1.5 W limit and the thermal derating curve at each VIN (section 7.10). The knowledge record omits the table conditions - knowledge maintenance suggested.

CMP-TPS2640 was used with I_OL as the trip threshold although MODE = open selects circuit-breaker mode, whose threshold is I_CB = 12/R_ILIM - 0.03 A with a 4 ms timeout and a 540 ms retry (SLVSFQ6A 9.3.5.1.2). The record describes the device as a '2 A eFuse' without the circuit-breaker threshold - knowledge maintenance suggested.

CB-PR-002 / CMP-UCC21710-Q1 APWM transfer function applied with inverted polarity (the records do not state polarity; the datasheet does: 88 % at 0.6 V, 10 % at 4.5 V) - add the polarity to CB-PR-002.

KR-GD-008 exclusion ('short on-board links') extended to a board-to-board mezzanine; acceptable as an 'adapted' application with the documented RS-422 fallback, but the rule's measurement verification (common-mode injection, open-connector test) must appear in the test plan rather than being treated as closed.
required_changes: Correct the APWM decode polarity everywhere (firmware contract, eCAP decode, hardware OTP comparator sense): D = 0.88 - 0.200 x (V_AIN - 0.6 V); hot NTC -> higher duty -> higher filtered voltage; open sensor -> about 10 % duty.

Replace the eFuse margin statement: in MODE = open the trip is the circuit-breaker threshold I_CB = 12/R_ILIM - 0.03 A (about 1.46 A typ, about 1.3 A min for 8.06 k) after tCB(dly) 4 ms with a 540 ms auto-retry; quote the margin against I_CB and describe the consequence of a retry (control power cycles, drivers disabled through RST/EN, relay releases after about 15 ms at near-zero current).

Re-run the 12 V budget with the relay actually selected by the sensing agent (Omron G9EA-1 DC12, 417 mA -> 1.11 A at 10.8 V) or agree a lower-power relay / PWM hold; re-select R_ILIM accordingly and replace the 1N4148W-class freewheel diode by a >= 1 A part if the 417 mA coil stays.
State the fan connection point: the external 12 V fan must be fed upstream of the TPS26400 (directly from the 12 V entry) or be included in the ILIM/I_CB selection.

Remove the claim that the UCC14141-Q1 budget is covered by a flat 1.0 W rating over 8-18 V; evaluate the LS module against the SLUSF10B SOA/derating curve at 10.8 V and the actual power-board ambient with a consistent LS load (Q_G 125 nC from the MOSFET agent; sensing LDO 0.25 W typ / 0.35 W max from the sensing agent; 41 mA case from the gate-driver agent), and coordinate the firmware 10.8 V floor / eFuse UVLO with that result (KR-PR-003 review input).

Fix the 5 V supervisor statement: TPS3808G01 VIT = 0.405 V, so 105 k / 10 k trips at 4.66 V (release up to about 4.80 V); either state 4.66 V and confirm the 5 V set-point tolerance keeps the rail above 4.80 V, or use about 101-102 k for a 4.5 V threshold.

Add defined pull resistors on every DSP-driven control net in the GPIO0-GPIO11 group (no reset pull-ups per SPRS439): 10 k pull-downs on PWM_H, PWM_L and ARM at the SN74LVC2G08 / SN74LVC1G74 inputs, a pull-up on DSP_TRIP_N and on the E-stop input; keep the RELAY_ON and BIAS_EN pull-downs and the UCC21710 internal 50 k on RST/EN.

Reconcile the mezzanine net list with the architecture partition: route the AMC1311 OUTP/OUTN pairs (or move the OPA2320 difference stages to the power-board SELV strip) and provide the TMCS1133 V_OC reference on the power board (ratiometric from 3V3_PWRBOARD) or on a connector pin; define or drop ISENSE_REF; correct the ground-pin count to 24; note that only the LS NTC/APWM channel is used by the gate-driver and sensing agents (TEMP_PWM_H becomes a spare).
Use the datasheet dVdT relation (slew = 24.6 x I_dVdT / C, I_dVdT 4-5.5 uA): 8.9-12.2 ms ramp at 12 V with 100 nF (10.4 ms typ) and 0.19-0.26 A charging current.

Harmonise the ADC front-end values with the sensing agent (100 ohm / 1 nF here versus 1 k + 1 nF for VIN/VOUT) and the precharge closing criterion (320 V here versus 340 V in the sensing agent's sequence; both rely on the dV/dt settling test).

Move 'UCC14141-Q1 ENA threshold', 'TPS54302 EN threshold' and 'SN74LV21A tpd at 3.3 V' from unverified to verified (2.1 V max rising / 0.8 V min falling; 1.23 V typ / 1.28 V max rising, 1.16 V falling; 8.5 ns max at 15 pF, 12 ns at 50 pF) and keep SMBJ15CA, Samtec/Wurth connector data, relay and AO3400A as unverified.
summary: The section's architecture (SELV control domain, TPS26400 eFuse with a derived UVLO/OVP ladder, V1 supply chain, SN74LVC2G08 gating + SN74LVC1G74 latch + SN74LV21A combiner, UCC21710 cross-wired interlock, stacked 2x25 mezzanine, F28335 pin map) is sound and 18 of 22 calculations reproduce exactly; TPS2640, UCC21710, UCC14141 input-current, F28335, TPS54302, TPS767D3, TPS3808 and logic parameters were confirmed from datasheet text. Four statements are contradicted by datasheets: the APWM duty polarity is inverted (88 % at 0.6 V, 10 % at 4.5 V), the TPS3808 105k/10k divider trips at 4.66 V not 4.5 V, the eFuse margin must be quoted against the circuit-breaker threshold I_CB (about 1.46 A typ) rather than I_OL in MODE = open, and the flat '1.0 W over 8-18 V' UCC14141 rating is not what the electrical table specifies (0.7 W at 85 degC / 25 V; SOA by derating curve). Cross-area inconsistencies remain: the sensing agent's 417 mA relay coil (1.11 A total, about 1.17x on I_CB), an undefined fan connection point, and connector nets missing for the AMC1311 differential outputs and the TMCS1133 V_OC reference under the architecture's partition. GPIO0-11 have no reset pull-ups (verified), so ARM/PWM/DSP_TRIP_N need defined pull resistors. None of these overturn the design; all are precise corrections.
